reviews.text: I was expecting only some additional moisture but this has completely changed my skin for the better. Since I started using the product my skin has gotten brighter and looks really soft. I have had to use less make up to cover some discoloration that I had and I feel more confident without wearing makeup. Also, my breakouts have lessened and are less than the breakouts I had before.
reviews.zh: 我本來只係期望多啲水分，但係呢款完全改變咗我嘅皮膚，變得更好。自從我開始用呢款產品，我嘅皮膚變得更亮，睇落真係好柔軟。我以前有啲色沉，而家只需要用少啲化妝去遮蓋，我唔化妝都更有自信。另外，我嘅爆痘情況都減少咗，少過以前。

reviews.text: Bought it beacuse some reviews said you could use it as a moisturiser for oily skin but turned out I couldn't; it absorbs way too fast and it doesn't lock in moisture but just provides hydration deep in the skin(it is an essence afterall duh). After using it for some time and then getting a proper moisturizer and using those two together my skin felt so much better and plumper and hydrated. Then I ran out of the essence and I could noticeably tell the difference in how my skin felt without it. I'm waiting for my second bottle to arrive now. Also it's great that a bottle lasts me 5 months!
reviews.zh: 我買咗係因為有啲評論話，油性皮膚可以當保濕霜用，但原來我唔可以；佢吸收得太快，唔會鎖住水分，只係為皮膚深層補充水分（佢始終係精華，當然啦）。我用咗一段時間，之後再買咗合適嘅保濕霜，兩樣一齊用，我嘅皮膚感覺好好好多，更加飽滿同水潤。之後我用完咗精華，就清楚感覺到冇佢嗰時皮膚嘅分別。而家我等緊第二支到。另外，一樽可以用五個月，好好！

reviews.text:
What I love about cosrx is the minimalist of ingredients in their products. Having sensitive skin I’m always a little nervous before trying a new product but this I’m so pleased with!

I like the idea of an essence giving another layer oh hydration and this does just that and it can be layered and feels like nothing on the skin. it’ll be wet and tacky for about 20 seconds then fully dries down. it’s got no fragrance to it and it’s more of a watery gel consistency which feels great on the skin. 

This will be especially good for summer when I don’t want too many thick feeling products but still want hydration since I’ve got dry skin. I highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
我鍾意 cosrx 嘅地方，就係佢哋嘅產品成分都好簡約。我皮膚敏感，所以試新產品之前都會有啲緊張，但係呢款我好滿意！

我鍾意精華可以多加一層水分嘅概念，呢款就做到咗，而且可以疊用，塗喺皮膚上感覺似乎冇嘢咁。大約 20 秒會濕濕黏黏，之後就完全乾咗。佢冇香味，質地比較似水狀嘅凝膠，塗喺皮膚上感覺好好。

呢款特別適合夏天，因為我唔想用太多厚重嘅產品，但係我皮膚乾，所以仍然需要補水。我好推薦！

reviews.text: Tried this in place of the snail mucin essence and have really enjoyed how nice it feels on the skin and how it gives instant moisture to the face. My face feels very hydrated after I put it on and doesn't feel as sticky as the snail mucin essence. Really happy that I was able to try this out, and hopefully this will be in stock soon!
reviews.zh: 我用呢款代替咗蝸牛黏液精華，真係好鍾意佢喺皮膚上嘅感覺，以及即刻為面部補充水分嘅效果。搽咗之後面好水潤，而且冇蝸牛黏液精華咁黏。好開心可以試用呢款，希望好快有貨！

reviews.text: Love this essence so much. Very hydrating and makes my skin so soft. I stopped using it for a few days and didn’t even realize how rough my skin had gotten until I went back to using the essence! I have combo acne prone skin and this product does not break me out. I think it actually brightens my skin and lightens acne marks (even though I don’t think there’s specific brightening ingredients in the product?). Recommend!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款精華。補水效果好好，令我嘅皮膚好柔軟。我停咗用幾日，直到再用返精華，先發現我嘅皮膚之前變得幾粗糙！我係混合性、易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，呢款產品唔會令我爆痘。我覺得佢實際上可以提亮皮膚，同埋淡化暗瘡印（雖然我唔覺得產品入面有特定嘅提亮成分？）。推薦！

reviews.text: My first time using an essence but I'm really impressed. It gives my skin extra moisture. And keeps my face hydrated the whole day or if I use it at night, I wake up with baby smooth skin. It's slightly sticky when you apply it but after your skin absorbs it you can't really feel it. So it's not an issue for me.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次用精華液，但係真係好有驚喜。佢令皮膚多咗水分，成日都保持面部水潤；或者如果我晚上用，醒返嚟皮膚會滑得好似BB咁。搽嗰陣有少少黏，但係皮膚吸收咗之後就真係感覺唔到，所以對我嚟講唔係問題。

reviews.text: I'm happy I bought this! It's very hydrating, and a little goes a long way (1-2 pumps cover my face, neck & hands). Also it feels cool and plesant on the skin, & my pores look smaller~ (cooling effects help close & tighten pores). Will buy again, i love what this does to my skin. (I have dry/combination skin & history of severe adult acne).
reviews.zh: 我好開心買咗呢款！補水效果好好，而且用少少就夠用（一至兩泵就可以覆蓋我嘅面、頸同手）。塗喺皮膚上又有清涼嘅感覺，我嘅毛孔睇落細咗～（清涼效果有助收細同收緊毛孔）。會再買，我好鍾意佢對皮膚嘅效果。（我嘅皮膚係乾性／混合性，而且有成人嚴重暗瘡嘅病史）。

reviews.text: Cosrx never really seems to fail me and this product was no exception! It seemed as if my skin really have been needing this product as it ended up beating almost the majority of my moisturizers. A lot of moisturizing products will just end up "sitting" on your skin like a barrier and whilst that is not always bad, this product is on another skin-treating level. It is easily absorbed yet you can really tell how much smoother, more hydrated and ,oddly enough how, how much "stronger" your skin feels. The product is also very nicely formulated with sea bucktorn (rich in vitamin c) as the first ingredient that works great with the hyaluronic acid. I would really recommend this product, which I did to my mom who also fell in love. 10/10
reviews.zh: Cosrx 好似從來都唔會令我失望，呢款都係一樣！我嘅皮膚好似真係需要呢款產品咁，因為佢幾乎打敗咗我大部分嘅保濕霜。好多保濕產品只係會「坐」喺皮膚上面，好似一道屏障咁，雖然唔一定係壞事，但呢款產品好似更高一級嘅護膚功效。佢容易吸收，你真係可以感受到皮膚幾幼滑、幾水潤，而且（奇怪地）感覺皮膚幾「強韌」。產品配方都好好，第一成分係沙棘（富含維他命 C），同透明質酸配合得好好。我真係好推薦呢款產品，我亦推薦畀我媽媽，佢都愛上咗。10/10

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
